answer: By the nebula of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A whisper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the umber of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
